captured_from: the operator's installer transcript of 2026-09-27 19:11:45, the third of three Update attempts
why: This is the argument list the INSTALLED BASE sends. The updater-cycle gate proved the
cycle from the previous release's updater, which passes a different list, so the guard
that refuses this one was never exercised: 'Application, operator-data, and workspace
directories must be three disjoint trees', because the workspace sits inside the data
root. The version that most needs the update was the one that could not take it.
Placeholders are substituted by the gate so the replay runs on disposable roots.
{data} is the data root, {application} the application root, {workspace} the workspace
the updater sends, and {progress} the progress file.
observed_refusal: Application, operator-data, and workspace directories must be three disjoint trees.
